question.text: If in <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">I</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>6</mn></mrow></msub></math> the number of covalent bonds and coordinate bonds are m and n respectively. Find the sum of m + n.

solution.text:
It contains 6 covalent bonds and 2 coordinate bonds.

i.e., m = 6, n = 2

m + n = 6 + 2 = 8
